scripts.factory:check: tailscale funnel status && curl -fsSI -o /dev/null --doh-url https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query "https://$(tailscale status --json | jq -r '.Self.DNSName | rtrimstr(".")')/" && echo 'Reachable from the internet' || { echo 'NOT reachable from the internet, so GitHub webhooks fail. See the factory README: Start the factory'; exit 1; }
